user.title: Awenta HRV
user.description: Local mode: the units connect to Home Assistant (needs the DNS record described in the README). Cloud mode: control through Awenta's cloud with your Awenta account.

local.title: Local mode
local.description: Home Assistant listens for the units on this port. Point ahr.awenta.pl at this Home Assistant (see the README) and power-cycle each unit once.

init.title: Awenta HRV connection
init.description: Switching mode reloads the integration. Local mode needs ahr.awenta.pl to point at this Home Assistant. Unit names are used for entity names of newly created entities.

error.cloud_needs_account: This entry was created in local mode and has no Awenta account; add a cloud entry instead.
